## Rockwell Medical to Exhibit at ASN Kidney Week 2026


10/14/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 170 KB](https://s201.q4cdn.com/332113476/files/doc_news/Rockwell-Medical-to-Exhibit-at-ASN-Kidney-Week-2026-2026.pdf)


WIXOM, Mich.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Rockwell Medical, Inc. (the "Company") (Nasdaq: RMTI), a healthcare company that develops, manufactures, commercializes, and distributes a portfolio of hemodialysis products to dialysis providers worldwide, today announced that the Company is exhibiting its hemodialysis concentrates portfolio in Booth #1049 at the[American Society of Nephrology ("ASN") Kidney Week 2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.asn-online.org%2Feducation%2Fkidneyweek%2F&esheet=54621616&newsitemid=20261014434625&lan=en-US&anchor=American+Society+of+Nephrology+%28%26quot%3BASN%26quot%3B%29+Kidney+Week+2026&index=1&md5=8c45bdf8a02e561d4fce3dd78654190e) , which will be held October 21-25 at the Colorado Convention Center in Denver, CO.


More information about Rockwell Medical's hemodialysis concentrates product portfolio can be found on the Company's website:[www.rockwellmed.com/hemodialysis-products](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rockwellmed.com%2Fhemodialysis-products%2F&esheet=54621616&newsitemid=20261014434625&lan=en-US&anchor=www.rockwellmed.com%2Fhemodialysis-products&index=2&md5=de14d2819fd602c2e5a2137fbde04486) .


**About Rockwell Medical**


Rockwell Medical, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMTI) is a healthcare company that develops, manufactures, commercializes, and distributes a portfolio of hemodialysis products for dialysis providers worldwide. Rockwell Medical's mission is to provide dialysis clinics and the patients they serve with the highest quality products supported by the best customer service in the industry. Rockwell is focused on innovative, long-term growth strategies that enhance its products, its processes, and its people, enabling the Company to deliver exceptional value to the healthcare system and provide a positive impact on the lives of hemodialysis patients. Hemodialysis is the most common form of end-stage kidney disease treatment and is typically performed in freestanding outpatient dialysis centers, hospital-based outpatient centers, skilled nursing facilities, or a patient’s home. Rockwell Medical's products are vital to vulnerable patients with end-stage kidney disease, and the Company is relentless in providing unmatched reliability and customer service. Certified as a Great Place to Work® four years in a row (2023-2026) and named Fortune Best Workplaces in Manufacturing & Production™ three years in a row (2024-2026), Rockwell Medical is *Driven to Deliver Life-Sustaining Dialysis Solutions™* . For more information, visit[www.rockwellmed.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rockwellmed.com%2F&esheet=54621616&newsitemid=20261014434625&lan=en-US&anchor=www.rockwellmed.com&index=3&md5=75e6aaa016f0e4a22d1f0d7bb7ce634f) .
